toegepas.voor: Fyn kwartsstof kom in die lug
toegepas.na: Fyn kwartsstof beland in die lug
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Kom in die lug' is loose; 'beland in die lug' is the natural way to say dust gets into the air, with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'kom in die lug' is a loose verb for dust being thrown up into the air
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'beland in die lug' is the more exact natural verb, describes the same event, is not a safety instruction, and leaves the protected 'kwartsstof' intact.
